description: This file defines API endpoints for managing emojis and reactions in a sports live stream platform. It uses FastAPI to create RESTful routes for listing emojis, submitting reactions, and fetching reaction summaries, handling interactions with repositories and real-time websocket updates.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list available emojis with pagination, returning a list of emojis and total counts.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a user emoji reaction for an event, updating counts and broadcasting updates via websockets.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve reaction summaries for a specific event.
